verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents programmatic surfaces that support headless automation: custom integration push APIs and integration monitoring, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, and inbound webhooks. Its GitHub compliance-skills package (installed via npx) runs PII and GDPR checks during code generation and repo audits. None of this is shown running in a CI pipeline, though, and the core product is described as dashboard-driven. missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline gating), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), API authentication and headless-usage docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of CI use.
